source_rationale: SWE-bench Verified supplies 500 engineer-verified real repository issues with base commits, problem statements, gold patches, test patches, and official container evaluation metadata. It is large enough to construct an eligibility pool before fixed-seed stratified sampling.
known_source_limitations: The public benchmark may have appeared in model training or evaluation data, so exploratory results cannot establish contamination-free generalization.
The official harness is resource intensive and recommends x86_64; arm64 support is experimental.
Dataset and harness revisions are independently pinned before any exploratory task outcome.
Engineer verification does not guarantee that a pinned local environment remains reproducible; every candidate must pass the frozen base/gold preflight.
inclusion_requirements: The instance exists exactly once in the pinned dataset revision and has a full base_commit, problem_statement, patch, test_patch, FAIL_TO_PASS, and PASS_TO_PASS record.
The repository license and task artifacts permit local research evaluation and archival of hashes and metadata.
A clean pinned snapshot builds under a pinned SWE-bench harness and Docker runtime without credentials, GPU, Git LFS, submodules, or live external services.
Two clean base runs reproduce at least one designated FAIL_TO_PASS failure and agree on the evaluator outcome.
Two clean gold-patch runs pass the official evaluator and agree on the evaluator outcome.
Agent and evaluator execution succeed with network disabled after immutable image acquisition.
Setup, checkout size, and evaluator duration remain within the frozen resource limits.
The task has not appeared in this project's exposure registry and has not been inspected through an earlier mini-SWE task outcome.

stratum_definitions.localization: The issue does not identify the production file or symbol ultimately changed; the gold fix changes one production file, so locating the target is the primary difficulty.
stratum_definitions.single_file: The gold fix changes exactly one production file and the task does not meet a higher-precedence stratum definition.
stratum_definitions.multi_file_interface: The gold fix changes at least two production files across an interface, call boundary, serialization contract, or distinct package modules.
stratum_definitions.config_cli: The externally visible behavior is governed by configuration parsing, command-line handling, environment options, or packaging metadata.
stratum_definitions.test_regression: The fix must preserve at least one PASS_TO_PASS group while resolving two or more distinct FAIL_TO_PASS tests or failure signatures.
stratum_definitions.measurement_disambiguation: The issue and initial failing test do not uniquely identify the root cause; at least one additional public measurement can distinguish two plausible causes before mutation.
